name: Tsukino Miyu
source:
The no-nonsense chief of the guardians. She was tasked by the village leader together with Narumi to deal with the thieving foxgirls. However, she rarely cooperates with her and often does her own thing instead. She claims that she dislikes working with other people because she can’t stand the awkwardness she feels. The MC is also most intimidated by her.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=120]MangaGamer[/url]]
